text: Which oligodendrocyte-specific genes (single-cell) have no detectable mRNA in liver?
plan: Tissue category (RNA): Liver / Not detected AND Cell type category (scRNA): Oligodendrocytes / Cell type enriched
understanding: The user is asking for genes showing oligodendrocyte-specific RNA expression at the single-cell level, while having no detectable RNA (mRNA) in liver tissue.

trail.why: Selecting 'liver' at Level 1 and 'Not detected' at Level 2 precisely identifies genes with mRNA levels below the detection cut-off in liver tissue.

The requirement specifically asks for oligodendrocyte-specific genes, which corresponds to the 'Cell type enriched' category (at least four-fold higher mRNA level compared to any other cell type) for Oligodendrocytes.

requirements.why: This field classifies RNA specificity and distribution across human tissues (including 'liver') and allows selecting the category for genes not detected or lacking detectable mRNA, unlike 'Tissue expression (IHC)' which measures protein staining.
the field's option "Oligodendrocytes" names what the requirement names
